def deterministic_points(
    mask: np.ndarray,
    class_id: int,
    modulus: int = POINT_HASH_MODULUS,
) -> np.ndarray:
    coords_zyx = np.argwhere(mask)
    z = coords_zyx[:, 0].astype(np.uint64)
    y = coords_zyx[:, 1].astype(np.uint64)
    x = coords_zyx[:, 2].astype(np.uint64)
    hashed = (
        (z * 73856093)
        ^ (y * 19349663)
        ^ (x * 83492791)
        ^ np.uint64(class_id * 2654435761)
    )
    return coords_zyx[(hashed % modulus) == 0]

def add_class_layer(
    ax: plt.Axes,
    labels: np.ndarray,
    class_id: int,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    class_mask = labels == class_id
    surface_mask = class_mask[
        ::SURFACE_GRID_COARSEN,
        ::SURFACE_GRID_COARSEN,
        ::SURFACE_GRID_COARSEN,
    ]
    surface_spacing = DISPLAY_SPACING_MM_ZYX * SURFACE_GRID_COARSEN
    vertices_zyx, faces, _normals, _values = marching_cubes(
        surface_mask.astype(np.uint8),
        level=0.5,
        spacing=tuple(float(value) for value in surface_spacing),
        step_size=1,
        allow_degenerate=False,
    )
    vertices_xyz = vertices_zyx[:, [2, 1, 0]]
    surface = Poly3DCollection(
        vertices_xyz[faces],
        facecolors=CLASS_COLORS[class_id],
        edgecolor="none",
        alpha=SURFACE_ALPHA,
        shade=True,
        lightsource=mpl.colors.LightSource(azdeg=LIGHT_AZIMUTH, altdeg=LIGHT_ALTITUDE),
        linewidth=0,
        rasterized=True,
    )
    ax.add_collection3d(surface)

    coords_zyx = deterministic_points(class_mask, class_id)
    coords_mm_zyx = coords_zyx * DISPLAY_SPACING_MM_ZYX
    ax.scatter(
        coords_mm_zyx[:, 2],
        coords_mm_zyx[:, 1],
        coords_mm_zyx[:, 0],
        s=POINT_SIZE,
        c=CLASS_COLORS[class_id],
        marker=CLASS_MARKERS[class_id],
        alpha=POINT_ALPHA,
        depthshade=False,
        linewidths=0,
        rasterized=True,
    )
    return {
        "display_grid_voxels": int(np.count_nonzero(class_mask)),
        "surface_vertices": int(len(vertices_xyz)),
        "surface_faces": int(len(faces)),
        "render_points": int(len(coords_zyx)),
    }

def add_surface_layer(
    ax: plt.Axes,
    mask: np.ndarray,
    color: str,
    alpha: float,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Add a fixed 0.5 isosurface from a binary display-grid class mask."""
    if not np.any(mask):
        return {"display_grid_voxels": 0, "surface_vertices": 0, "surface_faces": 0}
    vertices_zyx, faces, _normals, _values = marching_cubes(
        mask.astype(np.uint8),
        level=0.5,
        spacing=tuple(float(value) for value in DISPLAY_SPACING_MM_ZYX),
        step_size=1,
        allow_degenerate=False,
    )
    vertices_xyz = vertices_zyx[:, [2, 1, 0]]
    ax.add_collection3d(
        Poly3DCollection(
            vertices_xyz[faces],
            facecolors=color,
            edgecolor="none",
            alpha=alpha,
            shade=True,
            lightsource=mpl.colors.LightSource(azdeg=LIGHT_AZIMUTH, altdeg=LIGHT_ALTITUDE),
            linewidth=0,
            rasterized=True,
        )
    )
    return {
        "display_grid_voxels": int(np.count_nonzero(mask)),
        "surface_vertices": int(len(vertices_xyz)),
        "surface_faces": int(len(faces)),
    }

def corners(low, high):
    return np.array(list(itertools.product(*zip(low, high))), float)

def draw_scene(labels, stride, spacing, *, surface_coarsen, water_alpha,
               roi_zyx=None, pixels=1600):
    stride, spacing = np.asarray(stride, int), np.asarray(spacing, float)
    displayed = np.array(labels[::stride[0], ::stride[1], ::stride[2]], copy=True)
    ns = reference.original_functions(stride*spacing, surface_coarsen)
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6.36, 6.), dpi=pixels/6, facecolor=BACKGROUND)
    ax = fig.add_axes([.04, .04, .92, .92], projection="3d")
    ax.set_facecolor(BACKGROUND)
    ax.set_proj_type("ortho")
    ax.view_init(elev=20, azim=-55, roll=0)
    records = {}
    for cid in reversed(range(3, 8)):
        if np.any(displayed == cid):
            records[reference.NAMES[cid]] = ns["add_class_layer"](ax, displayed, cid)
    context = reference.original_functions(stride*spacing*2)
    water = displayed[::2, ::2, ::2] == 2
    if water.any():
        records["Water"] = context["add_surface_layer"](
            ax, water, reference.PALETTE[2], water_alpha)
    for collection in ax.collections:
        collection.set_clip_on(False)
    extent = np.asarray(labels.shape) * spacing
    for start, end in ns["box_edges_xyz"](extent):
        ax.plot([start[0], end[0]], [start[1], end[1]], [start[2], end[2]],
                color="#7F8B94", alpha=.26, lw=.45, solid_capstyle="round", clip_on=False)
    z, y, x = extent
    ax.set(xlim=(0, x), ylim=(0, y), zlim=(0, z))
    ax.set_box_aspect((x, y, z), zoom=1.20)
    ax.set_axis_off()
    fig.canvas.draw()
    image = np.asarray(fig.canvas.buffer_rgba())[:, :, :3].copy()
    outer = corners([0, 0, 0], extent[::-1])
    roi = None
    if roi_zyx is not None:
        bounds = np.array(roi_zyx) * spacing[:, None]
        roi = corners(bounds[::-1, 0], bounds[::-1, 1])
    def project_points(points):
        xx, yy, zz = proj3d.proj_transform(*points.T, ax.get_proj())
        p = ax.transData.transform(np.c_[xx, yy])
        p[:, 1] = image.shape[0] - p[:, 1]
        return p
    scene = {"image": image, "outer": project_points(outer),
             "roi": None if roi is None else project_points(roi)}
    record = {
        "source_shape_zyx": list(labels.shape),
        "display_grid_shape_zyx": list(displayed.shape),
        "display_stride_zyx": stride.tolist(),
        "surface_additional_stride": surface_coarsen,
        "water_additional_stride": 2, "coordinate_spacing_zyx": spacing.tolist(),
        "oil_alpha": reference.OIL_ALPHA, "oil_point_alpha": reference.OIL_POINT_ALPHA,
        "water_alpha": water_alpha, "phase_records": records}
    plt.close(fig); gc.collect()
    return scene, record

def image_panel(fig, rect, scene, letter):
    ax = fig.add_axes(rect, label=letter)
    ax.imshow(scene["image"], interpolation="none")
    ax.set_axis_off()
    h, w = scene["image"].shape[:2]
    ax.set(xlim=(-.5, w-.5), ylim=(h-.5, -.5))
    ax.text(.01, 1.01, letter, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9,
            weight="bold", color=INK, ha="left", va="bottom")
    points = scene["roi"]
    if points is not None:
        for i in range(8):
            for j in range(i):
                # Cartesian corner ordering: an edge differs in one binary bit.
                if (i ^ j) not in (1, 2, 4):
                    continue
                xy = points[[i, j]]
                line, = ax.plot(xy[:, 0], xy[:, 1], lw=.75, color=LOCATOR, zorder=5)
                line.set_path_effects([pe.Stroke(linewidth=1.35, foreground=BACKGROUND), pe.Normal()])
    return ax

sampling_overview.py::link.text:
def link(fig, left, right, scene_left, scene_right):
    a, b = scene_left["roi"], scene_right["outer"]
    # Paired non-crossing leaders from right side of source ROI to left side
    # of magnified box. Exact projected coordinates, no decorative relocation.
    a_ids = np.argsort(a[:, 0])[-4:]
    b_ids = np.argsort(b[:, 0])[:4]
    for upper in (True, False):
        pick = np.argmin if upper else np.argmax
        ia, ib = a_ids[pick(a[a_ids, 1])], b_ids[pick(b[b_ids, 1])]
        fig.add_artist(ConnectionPatch(
            xyA=a[ia], coordsA="data", axesA=left,
            xyB=b[ib], coordsB="data", axesB=right,
            color=LOCATOR, alpha=.58, lw=.60, linestyle=(0, (3, 3)),
            zorder=3, clip_on=False))

def pooled_scene(initial, central=False, pixels=1600):
    oil, water = initial >= 3, initial == 2
    if central:
        keep = np.zeros_like(oil)
        keep[overview.CROP] = True
        oil &= keep
        water &= keep
    camera = native.make_camera(pixels, az=CAMERA["azimuth"], el=CAMERA["elevation"])
    if central:
        camera["span"] *= .5
    surface = native.mesh(oil, 7)
    depth, normals, categories = native.geometry_buffer(surface, camera)
    light_camera = native.make_camera(700, direction=native.LIGHT)
    if central:
        light_camera["span"] *= .5
    shadow, _, _ = native.geometry_buffer(surface, light_camera)
    rgb, _ = native.light_pixels(
        depth, normals, categories, oil, native.PALETTE,
        camera["center"], camera["right"], camera["up"], camera["view"], camera["span"],
        native.LIGHT, shadow, light_camera["center"], light_camera["right"],
        light_camera["up"], light_camera["view"], light_camera["span"])
    rgb[categories == 0] = mpl.colors.to_rgb(BACKGROUND)
    wd, wn, wc = native.geometry_buffer(native.mesh(water, 2), camera)
    visible = (wc == 2) & (wd >= depth)
    shade = .74 + .26 * np.maximum(wn @ native.LIGHT, 0)
    water_rgb = native.PALETTE[2][None, None, :] * shade[..., None]
    rgb[visible] = .88 * rgb[visible] + .12 * water_rgb[visible]
    low, high = ([31.5]*3, [95.5]*3) if central else ([-.5]*3, [127.5]*3)
    outer = native.project(overview.corners(low, high), camera)[:, :2]
    roi = None if central else native.project(
        overview.corners([31.5]*3, [95.5]*3), camera)[:, :2]
    scene = {"image": np.rint(np.clip(rgb, 0, 1)*255).astype(np.uint8),
             "outer": outer, "roi": roi, "depth": depth, "camera": camera}
    record = {
        "source_shape_zyx": [128]*3, "display_shape_zyx": [64 if central else 128]*3,
        "native_oil_voxels": int(oil.sum()), "native_oil_triangles": len(surface["faces"]),
        "oil_classes_pooled_for_display": True, "oil_opacity": 1., "water_opacity": .12,
        "surface_grid_stride": 1, "isosurface": .5, "geometry_smoothing": False,
        "lighting": "Smooth-normal depth-buffered light and contact shading on the native mask",
        "coordinate_spacing_zyx": [1, 1, 1]}
    del surface, normals, categories, shadow, wd, wn, wc
    gc.collect()
    return scene, record
